description: Research paper or thesis chapter: standard IMRaD sections and numbered figure/table captions.

required_headers.description: Summary section near the start of the paper.
Opening section stating the problem and contribution.
Methods section under any of its common names.
Reference list at the end of the paper.

regex_rules.description: At least one numbered caption such as 'Figure 1' or 'Table 2', at the start of a paragraph (Docling emits captions as paragraph nodes).
In-text citations in numeric '[3]' or author-year '(Smith et al., 2021)' style.
